275422962.description: This lot includes a mix of vintage blank audio cassette tapes from well-known brands such as Sony (HF 90, CD-IT 94), TDK (D90, Superior D90), Maxell (UR 90), Memorex (High Bias II 90), and Radio Shack (Concertape C-60). The majority of the tapes are 90-minute Type I (Normal Bias). Also included is a Panasonic NV-TCL20PT video head cleaning cassette designed for VHS and VHS-C devices. Packaging varies from sealed to original vintage with visible wear and dust, especially on the Radio Shack 3-pack. A diverse collection for those interested in authentic vintage audio tapes.

275743339.description:
Natural Quartz Crystal Cluster
Large Specimen, Clear to Milky Translucency
Natural Geological Formation, 6.15 lbs
This impressive natural quartz crystal cluster features multiple prominent points radiating from a solid crystalline base. The specimen displays a range of transparency from clear, light-refracting terminations to a denser milky white interior. Quartz is one of the most abundant and diverse minerals on Earth, prized by collectors for its geometric crystal habits, natural brilliance, and aesthetic sculptural form.
Multiple large, distinct crystal points with natural facets and terminations
Natural clear to milky white coloration with minor internal veining and light mineral staining in crevices
Substantial crystalline base providing stability for display
Measures approximately 9 inches wide by 6 inches tall; weighs 6.15 lbs per scale
Condition:
Natural specimen condition. The crystal points show natural terminations with some minor edge wear or internal fractures typical of geological extraction and handling. Surface retains natural vitreous luster. Minor residual mineral deposits are present in the deeper crevices, consistent with its raw, natural origin.
